sample_unit: emergency department encounters (prospective gold-standard validation sample)

links.outcome: Agreement of deployed model flags with physician adjudication in a stratified prospective sample
links.effect: Within-stratum agreement 89.3% (model-positive) and 95.7% (model-negative); design-weighted sensitivity 0.40 (95% CI 0.24-0.64), specificity 0.996.
links.quote: In prospective gold‑standard validation (n = 217), 89.3% of model-positive encounters and 95.7% of model-negative encounters agreed with physician adjudication at the prespecified threshold.

unlisted_practices: Design-weighted (stratification-corrected) estimation of population-level sensitivity and specificity from a prediction-stratified validation sample

screen.reason: The study deploys a real-time predictive model embedded in the EHR to trigger clinical trial screening alerts and specifically evaluates operating-point threshold selection and prospective gold-standard validation in actual clinical care.

primary.practice: real-time EHR alert threshold selection and prospective validation
